headline: Presidential race: BNP collects two nomination forms
summary: The Bangladesh Nationalist Party has secured nomination papers from the Election Commission for the upcoming presidential election.
details: The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has collected two nomination forms for the upcoming presidential election. The forms were gathered from the office of Chief Election Commissioner A M M Nasir Uddin on Sunday.
caption:
BNP enters the presidential race. Two nomination forms have been collected from the Election Commission.

The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has collected two nomination forms for the upcoming presidential election. The forms were gathered from the office of Chief Election Commissioner A M M Nasir Uddin on Sunday.

headline_marked: [[Oli Ahmed nominated as candidate]] for presidential election by 11-party alliance
headline: Oli Ahmed nominated as candidate for presidential election by 11-party alliance
summary: The Jamaat-led alliance has selected Liberal Democratic Party Chairman Col (retd) Oli Ahmed to contest the election on August 20.
details: Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) Chairman Col (retd) Oli Ahmed has been nominated by the Jamaat-led 11-party alliance to contest the upcoming presidential election scheduled for August 20.
The nomination was announced by Opposition Chief Whip and National Citizen Party (NCP) Convener Nahid Islam during a press briefing today.
The announcement took place following a meeting of the alliance at the official residence of Jamaat chief and Opposition Leader Shafiqur Rahman on Minto Road, Dhaka.
The decision follows a previous announcement by Jamaat that it would participate in the presidential election with a candidate finalized through the 11-party alliance.
caption:
Col (retd) Oli Ahmed to contest the presidential election as the 11-party alliance candidate.

Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) Chairman Col (retd) Oli Ahmed has been nominated by the Jamaat-led 11-party alliance to contest the upcoming presidential election scheduled for August 20.

The nomination was announced by Opposition Chief Whip and National Citizen Party (NCP) Convener Nahid Islam during a press briefing today.

The announcement took place following a meeting of the alliance at the official residence of Jamaat chief and Opposition Leader Shafiqur Rahman on Minto Road, Dhaka.

The decision follows a previous announcement by Jamaat that it would participate in the presidential election with a candidate finalized through the 11-party alliance.
